task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an life changing round of TextWorld? You do! Here is how to play! First of all, open the antique trunk. After that, recover the old key from the antique trunk within the bedroom. With the old key, make it so that the wooden door in the bedroom is unlocked. And then, make sure that the wooden door is opened. Then, go east. Then, ensure that the screen door inside the kitchen is open. Then, attempt to travel east. If you can accomplish that, head south. And then, pick-up the bell pepper from the floor of the garden. And then, head north. Then, take a trip west. And then, place the bell pepper on the stove within the kitchen. Got that? Good!
